one_line: A senior Muslim merchant-diplomat from Calicut, carrying the Zamorin’s interests across the Indian Ocean coalition of Cairo, Gujarat, Chaul and Diu in 1508–1509.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s, lean but sturdy build, slightly weathered from sea travel.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp nose and defined cheekbones, medium brown Malabar complexion, neatly trimmed short black beard and moustache, calm observant eyes with a default expression of focused, diplomatic seriousness.
appearance.hair: Black hair, straight and medium length, combed back and tied into a low knot at the nape; covered by a deep-green, slightly tapered cloth turban wrapped smoothly with a subtle gold border along the edge.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early-16th-century Malabar Muslim merchant attire: a long-sleeved, knee-length cream cotton tunic (jama) with a front opening tied by small fabric loops, worn over loose ankle-length white cotton trousers; around the waist a broad maroon cotton sash is wrapped twice and knotted on the left, with one short end hanging; over the tunic he wears a sleeveless, hip-length dark-blue cotton waistcoat with simple vertical quilting and no metal fastenings, suggesting practical merchant status rather than warrior nobility; on his feet, brown leather sandals with a single strap and toe loop; he has a thin, dark-brown leather belt crossing diagonally from right shoulder to left hip to support his satchel; jewellery is modest but indicative of prosperity: a narrow gold ring on his right index finger, a simple gold hoop earring in his left ear, and a slender gold chain barely visible at the neck of the tunic; the fabrics look slightly worn from travel but well cared for, with no ornate embroidery beyond a very subtle geometric border in lighter blue on the edge of the waistcoat.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment map of the Indian Ocean trade routes tucked under his left arm, its outer layer bound by a red cord, paired with a small dark-brown leather document satchel hanging at his left hip; the satchel’s flap is secured by a simple brass toggle, and its shape is slightly bulged as if filled with contracts and letters bearing the Zamorin’s seal.

ref_desc: A late-30s Malabar merchant-envoy with a medium brown oval face, black hair in a low knot under a deep-green bordered turban, cream tunic, white trousers, maroon sash, dark-blue waistcoat, brown sandals, gold accents, and a red-cord bound parchment map with leather satchel.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a late-30s Malabar Muslim merchant-envoy from Calicut: lean build, medium brown oval face, sharp nose, short black beard and moustache, calm focused eyes, black hair tied in a low knot under a deep-green cloth turban with a subtle gold edging. He wears a knee-length cream cotton tunic with long sleeves and simple front ties over loose ankle-length white cotton trousers, cinched by a broad maroon sash wrapped twice at the waist and knotted on the left. Over the tunic is a sleeveless, hip-length dark-blue cotton waistcoat with slight vertical quilting and a narrow lighter-blue geometric border at the edges. His footwear is brown leather sandals with a single strap and toe loop. A thin dark-brown leather strap crosses his chest from right shoulder to left hip, supporting a small dark-brown leather document satchel that bulges slightly and closes with a brass toggle. He has a modest gold ring on his right index finger, a simple gold hoop in his left ear, and a faint gold chain at his neckline. In his left arm he carries a rolled parchment map of Indian Ocean trade routes, bound tightly by a red cord. Show front, side, and back views in the same frame, keeping the cream, dark blue, maroon, deep green, and brown palette consistent, and emphasize his composed diplomatic posture and practical, well-traveled merchant attire.
